reproduction_target: Computational integrative APA analysis identifying DDX55 as a 3'UTR-isoform regulator: RNA-seq processing of >500 ENCODE RBP-depletion experiments (BBDuk trimming, STAR v2.7.1a alignment, DaPars v0.9.1 tandem-PAS/dPDUI shift calling) + updated eCLIP peak calling (CLIPper v1.2.1 with a custom 500-nt downstream-extended annotation) + expressed-3'UTR/PAS-proximal binding analysis (Salmon v0.14.1, APASdb overlap) + motif discovery (Homer findMotifsGenome.pl) + targeted 3'end (QuantSeq) processing (Cutadapt, STAR v2.6.1a, custom cluster/PAS-assignment and internal-priming heuristics). Wet-lab siRNA knockdown / western / 3'RACE / QuantSeq library prep are validation (W), out of computational-reproduction scope.
granularity_note: Coarse one-step-per-named-tool from biorxiv v1 JATS Methods prose (fetched via curl; WebFetch was 403-blocked). CRITICAL LIVENESS: the 'Availability of data and materials' statement says processed data AND 'code to reproduce figures ... will be published after peer review', and raw/processed 3'end-seq data 'deposited at GEO and will be available after peer review'. Therefore NO author code repository is currently public (no GitHub/GitLab/Zenodo URL anywhere in the paper) and the newly generated 3'end-seq data is embargoed with no accession disclosed. Third-party ENCODE inputs and APASdb are public. Standard open tools scored code=1 (tool itself available); author custom glue/figure/clustering code scored code=0 (embargoed). Wet-lab steps counted in W, not verdicted.

steps.label: BBDuk (BBTools suite) adapter removal + quality trimming of ENCODE RNA-seq fastq (ktrim=r k=23 mink=11 hdist=1 minlength=35 tpe tbo qtrim=r trimq=20 qin=33) — no version
FastQC post-trim QC confirmation — no version
STAR v2.7.1a alignment to hg38 with Ensembl v94 splice junctions (--alignSJoverhangMin 8; uniquely mapped reads retained)
DaPars v0.9.1 tandem-PAS shift detection on hg38 RefSeq (Coverage_cutoff=30; changing = |dPDUI|>=20% & adj-p<0.05; non-changing = |dPDUI|<5% & adj-p>0.05)

CLIPper v1.2.1 eCLIP peak calling on ENCODE read-2 bams (--bonferroni --superlocal --threshold-method binomial) using a CUSTOM 500-nt downstream-extended gff annotation (modified annotation files not released)
Samtools view extraction of read 2 (flag 128) from ENCODE eCLIP bams — no version
Salmon v0.14.1 quasi-mapping quantification of control samples on Ensembl v94 transcriptome (k-mer=31); expressed transcripts >=1 TPM median across controls
Homer findMotifsGenome.pl motif discovery under HepG2 DDX55 IDR peaks (-p 4 -rna -S 10 -len 4,5,6,7,8 -noknown) + sliding-window UGUA/AWUAAA frequency analysis — no version
Cutadapt adapter + polyA/polyT trimming of newly generated QuantSeq 3'end reads — no version; input 3'end-seq data embargoed (GEO, released after peer review; no accession)

STAR v2.6.1a alignment of trimmed QuantSeq 3'end reads (--outFilterType BySJout --outFilterMultimapNmax 200 --outFilterMismatchNoverLmax 0.6 --alignIntronMin 20 --alignIntronMax 1000000 --alignSJoverhangMin 8 ...); input 3'end-seq data embargoed

Custom 3'end-cluster definition, PAS assignment, internal-priming removal heuristics, binding/functional-target integration, and figure-reproduction code — author code embargoed ('will be published after peer review'); input data embargoed

headline.inference_inclusive_upper_bound: RI ceiling on 4/11 computational steps (the version-pinned standard-tool steps on public ENCODE data: STAR v2.7.1a, DaPars v0.9.1, CLIPper v1.2.1, Salmon v0.14.1). 7/11 steps cap at NI: 4 due to unpinned tool versions (BBDuk, FastQC, Samtools, Homer), and 3 due to embargoed newly-generated 3'end-seq input data and/or embargoed author code (Cutadapt, STAR v2.6.1a-3'end, and the custom clustering/integration/figure step). No env lockfile or container is claimed; exact pins are partial with no closure, so no step exceeds RI even under stage2. Author pipeline code and processed data are explicitly promised only 'after peer review' — currently no code repo exists.
headline.coverage: 11 computational steps assessed from biorxiv v1 Methods prose. 4 wet-lab validation steps (siRNA transfection/cell culture, western/fractionation, QuantSeq library prep+sequencing, 3'RACE) counted (W) but out of computational-reproduction scope.
